doc.name: Agoreta: where and when
doc.instructions: Read-only local facts for covered areas: which venues are open at a given place and time, opening hours of a venue (listed, or an estimate), public events, and how busy a place is by hour of the week (an estimate). Estimates are always marked basis=estimate; say so when you cite one. Call sources for coverage and licences. Opening hours are offered under ODbL-1.0 and require the attribution "© OpenStreetMap contributors".

tools.name: open_now
tools.title: Venues open at a place and time
tools.description: Lists venues within a radius of a point that are open at the given moment (default: now). Hours are either listed or an estimate (basis=estimate).

city.description: City name within a covered area; used when lat/lon are not given (the part of the city with most venues is used as the centre).

at.description: Moment to evaluate, ISO 8601. Without an offset it is the local time of the place. Default: now.

category.description: Venue category or parent category, e.g. cafe, restaurant, pub, gym, library. See sources for the list.

include_closed.description: Also return venues that are closed at that moment. Default false.

annotations.title: Venues open at a place and time

tools.name: opening_hours
tools.title: Opening hours of a venue
tools.description: Finds a venue by name (optionally near a point or in a city) and returns its regular weekly opening hours: listed, or an estimate (basis=estimate).

city.description: City name within a covered area; used when lat/lon are not given (the part of the city with most venues is used as the centre).

at.description: Moment to evaluate, ISO 8601. Without an offset it is the local time of the place. Default: now.

tools.name: events
tools.title: Public events near a place
tools.description: Lists public events near a point or in a city within a date range. Each event names its organiser or publisher and licence.

city.description: City name within a covered area; used when lat/lon are not given (the part of the city with most venues is used as the centre).

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: from + 7 days; at most 60 days.

radius_m.description: Radius in metres. Default 3000 around coordinates, 10000 for a city.

tools.name: rhythm
tools.title: When a place is busiest
tools.description: Estimates how busy the surroundings of a point are by hour of a day of the week (index against the place's weekly average, level 1-5, people rounded to tens), the peak hours, and the busiest spots nearby. Always an estimate.

city.description: City name within a covered area; used when lat/lon are not given (the part of the city with most venues is used as the centre).

at.description: Moment to evaluate, ISO 8601. Without an offset it is the local time of the place. Default: now.

day.description: Day of the week. Default: the day of `at` (today).

hour.description: Hour of the day (local). Default: the hour of `at` (now); with `day` alone the whole day is returned.

radius_m.description: Radius for the busiest spots nearby. Default 1500.

tools.name: sources
tools.title: Coverage and licences
tools.description: Returns the covered areas and categories, the date of the data, and the licences with the attribution to use when citing.
